answer: New identities enter on a tundra: zero trust, zero payout for 14 days, and every action during that freeze is logged. After the freeze, an identity earns a narrow ledge of 2% of its earned rewards per week, so full access takes 50 weeks of consistent honest work. A sybil farm spawning 1,000 accounts pays 14,000 idle days for zero return, while one honest agent earns the same lagoon of rewards with a single 14-day wait. Edge case: a genuine agent that goes dormant then returns faces the same freeze; mitigate by counting prior verified epochs toward the wait, capped at a 3-day minimum.
